$comment: Seed data for `loombridge genre init`. DATA, not code: the scaffolder must not carry genre vocabulary as TypeScript literals (genre-core-litmus.test.ts), and everything here is keyed by genreClass (twitch | systems | hybrid), never by a genre id. A genre WITH a hint-card pack seeds its subGenres, tunables, bands, asset roles, and exemplars from the card; the blocks here are what no card carries (the build plan) plus the fallback for a genre with no pack at all. Every seed must survive `validateGenreContract` unedited: the scaffolder re-validates before writing, and loombridge-genre-init.test.ts runs the REAL validator over every class and every shipped card.
